text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut. Standing in the paddock for the first time,
Cheval Grand looked pale as a ghost.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, let's introduce the Umamusume
making their Debut today! First up—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... U-Um... U-Uhh...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Whew...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm Cheval Grand!
N-Nice to meet y-you!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, y-yes... Um, I-I-I-I'm—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is that girl gonna be okay?
Seeing her so nervous makes me worried...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but that girl is Verxina's younger sister.
*The* Verxina who just won the Victoria Mile
two years in a row this spring!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really!? —Considering that, though,
I don't think you look very much alike...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... Did someone just say something about me?
No, I'm sure it's just my imagination.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Because there must still be people
out there who know about someone like me...)
Cheval-cha~n! Do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh, this voice—

Following Cheval Grand's reaction toward the voice,
I see her childhood friend, who was introduced to me
at a family restaurant the other day.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching closely, okay~?
So make sure to give it your absolute all, Cheval-chan!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ngggh...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you.
I'll... I'll make sure to give it my all...!
The cheer from her childhood friend seemed to invigorate her. The color returns to Cheval Grand's cheeks.
choice_data_list: Go out there and give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes... I'll do my best...!

It's her momentous Make a Debut.
I prayed she would run a great race
that would boost her confidence—
